summaries.n-super-intelligence: On Sept. 29 Trump said AI would officially be renamed "Super Intelligence" (Fox News). On 2026-10-04 the official @WhiteHouse account posted an announcement of a "Super Intelligence Force (SIF)", and Watcher.Guru and an @wallstreetbets post reported Elon Musk saying SpaceXAI will be renamed SpaceXSI; a 2026-10-15 post reports that the task force is due to hold its first meeting (e1:5). Super Inu ($SI), launched Sept. 21, re-pitched itself around the term; other coins followed, including another SI on pump.fun, 四 ("four", read as SI) on four.meme, Super Intelligence Force (SIF), Superintelligence Owl, two SpaceXSI coins on StonkFun, SpaceX Inu ($SI on Flap), Act II: The SI Prophecy, and two BNB Chain coins on Flap named TeslaSI ("Tesla Super Intelligence", pool created 2026-10-11, and a second whose Chinese metadata says it follows the SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI rename). Two coins named Tetsuo Super Intelligence (TSI; Clanker on Robinhood Chain and pump.fun on Solana) joined on 2026-10-18, with pools 2.8 and 4.6 hours old at discovery: traders' posts call TSI "another SI coin" and one says Elon Musk posted about it (e2:0), which is unverified. SPACEXSI and Ollie (pump.fun) left on 2026-10-17, and SIGF (pump.fun) and SuperHooks (Pons) on 2026-10-18, after their 24h pool volume stayed under $1,000. None is shown to be affiliated with the announcements. Smaller coins named for SpaceXSI or TSI under the $100K market cap bar are not counted. Measured: fourteen coins across all their pools.
summaries.n-flying-tesla-roadster: Coins named for the Tesla Roadster unveiling. Posts dated 2026-10-16 describe Tesla showing a next-generation Roadster with SpaceX cold-gas thrusters at SpaceX's Texas test site on the evening of 2026-10-15: it drove up a ramp, flipped in the air and landed, with a claimed 0-60 mph in 0.81 seconds and deliveries in 2028 (@niccruzpatane, @cb_doge); DEXTools quotes Tesla's "Real life, baby" caption and Elon Musk's reply "Turns out the future does have flying cars". Six coins carry the name: two FTR contracts on Solana's pump.fun (Flying Tesla Roadster, and "Farting Tesla Roadster", whose metadata says "Everyone came for the movie"), a 特斯拉能飞 ("flying tesla roadster") coin on BNB Chain (Flap), a second Flying Tesla Roadster (FTR) on Flap, Starman (STARMAN, "the driver of the flying Tesla Roadster") and, since 2026-10-18, Roadster (Flap), whose Chinese metadata refers to Musk and Tesla's new sports car and carries a QQ contact number. Posts of 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-18 announce FTR spot listings on KCEX, LBank and KuCoin Alpha (e1:3). The Meteora DBC FTR contracts left on 2026-10-17 and the Clanker 特斯拉能飞 on Robinhood Chain on 2026-10-18 after 24h pool volume under $1,000. The main pump.fun FTR says it pairs with $SPCX and $TSLA through OTC desks; its pool was created on 2026-10-15 at 02:08 UTC, before the unveiling, as was the Flap Roadster pool (04:28 UTC), while the other pools were created after it. An older FTR on StonkFun, created in August, predates the story and is not included, and a further pump.fun FTR is quarantined for an implausible market cap and extreme 24h move. These are traders' and the coins' own claims: no coin is shown to be affiliated with Tesla, SpaceX or Elon Musk, most are days old, and the story is a single event. Measured: six coins across all their pools.
summaries.n-perpetual-futures: Coins whose metadata describes perpetual-futures trading. Papertrade's site (papertrade.xyz, e1:1) says "1000x leverage, 0 market impact, 100% user owned, fully onchain on hyperliquid", and @papertrade_xyz posted that trading was expected to start at 14:00 UTC on 2026-10-10. Three coins named Paper (Papertrade) copy its tagline: two Clanker contracts on Base and Robinhood Chain whose pools were created about 44 and 28 hours before discovery and traded almost nothing in the last 24 hours (together under 0.01% of the narrative's volume) after about $52M and $11M the day before, and a third Clanker contract on Base whose pool was created about 18 hours before discovery and traded about $54M. The sources seen never name any of these contracts, and posts describe PAPER as in pre-market on MNX (2026-10-17) and "not yet tradable" (2026-10-15), with mint-and-stake mechanics on Hyperliquid (e1:7), so affiliation with Papertrade is not verified. EmpireX (EMPIREX, Pons, Robinhood Chain) says it is a perpetual trading hub powered by Hyperliquid, and @HyperEmpireX introduced it on 2026-10-16. Purps (PURPS, Meteora DBC) says it launches perp-backed tokens. Aloooong (pump.fun) calls itself the "First 10x PUMP long perpetual meme". These are the projects' and traders' own claims: revenue, leverage, payouts and affiliation among the coins are not verified. Measured: six coins across all their pools.
summaries.n-stock-paired-coins: Coins from launchpads and projects that tie memecoins to tokenized stocks. STONK (StonkFun) says "Launch tokens / Backed by stocks", and @LaunchOnSF posted on 2026-10-12 that coins can be launched paired with $XPL on StonkFun (e1:8). XSTOK says it lets users launch and trade tokens paired with stocks; @xstokfun posted on 2026-10-16 that xstok is open and pairs a coin with any stock on Raydium or Meteora, and a 2026-10-17 trader post reports the XSTOK / NVDAX pair at a $190.9K market cap (e1:8). OTC says "Over-The-Counter Desks, earn stocks, pre-ipo, and yield". GTA VI (GTA6, StonkFun) says holders earn $TTWO stock by airdrop. A 2026-10-18 post says Flap's "memestock-3" coin is paired with a tokenized GameStop stock on BNB Chain (e1:9); it is not counted. These are the projects' and traders' own claims: payouts, stock holdings and volumes are not verified, and no affiliation among the coins was checked. The Robinhood Chain stock-token coins (BORRO, IRIDIUS) and the AI-stocks meme BUBBLE are not counted. Measured: four coins across all their pools.

n-super-intelligence.notice: The White House SIF and SpaceXSI posts still date from 2026-10-04 (e1:5); a 2026-10-15 post reports the task force's first meeting is due (e1:5), and the newest $SI posts (2026-10-13 to 2026-10-17, e1:2) come from coin accounts and traders. Two Tetsuo Super Intelligence (TSI) coins joined: trader posts of 2026-10-18 call TSI "another SI coin" and relay an unverified claim that Elon Musk posted about it (e2:0). n-super-intelligence.interpretation: The rename story is real but two weeks old and the older coins fade: the twelve older coins together traded about $2.9M in the 24 hours to 04:00 UTC against $4.2M in the prior run's window, while the two TSI coins add about $13.2M (82% of the narrative's $16.1M), from pools that were hours old at discovery, one of them over 10x its market cap. None of the coins is shown to be affiliated with the announcements.

n-flying-tesla-roadster.notice: Posts of 2026-10-16 to 2026-10-18 (e1:3) are promotion, trader tallies and exchange listing notices: KCEX and LBank listed FTR on 2026-10-16 and KuCoin Alpha on 2026-10-18. n-perpetual-futures.notice: Papertrade's site (e1:1) and posts (e1:7) describe a Hyperliquid perpetuals exchange; 2026-10-17 posts describe PAPER as in pre-market on MNX and mention "$60 million in revenue" (e1:7), traders' figures. n-perpetual-futures.interpretation: Perpetual-futures venues are a real, dated theme, but the Paper coins are copy contracts that come and go within a day or two: volume moved from the two earlier contracts to a new one (24h volume $58.8M against $68.4M in the prior run's window, 94% of it in the new Base contract), nothing seen links any of them to Papertrade, and the new contract traded about five times its market cap. Treat the volume as young-pool trading.

n-stock-paired-coins.interpretation: Launchpads that pair coins with stocks keep appearing, but the coins are different products (a launchpad token, a desk platform, a reward coin) and every figure is the projects' own. 24h volume is $4.7M against $7.5M in the prior run's window, 80% of it STONK.

The figures are the projects' own and payouts are not verified. The coins are not shown to be affiliated with the people named, or with each other.
